entities.name: Mud-Tail
entities.description: Elderly gray nezumi of Kamigawa, guarded and distrustful of outsiders.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: Planeswalker seeking information about the nezumi Nashi and the destruction of his village.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Powerful adversary the nezumi fear retaliation from.

events.summary: Mud-Tail encounters Kaito, who asks about Nashi and the fire that destroyed the village; she denies knowing anything.
events.quote: Mud-Tail remained guarded and denied knowing anything about Nashi or the fire that destroyed the village.

events.summary: Mud-Tail warns Kaito to leave the village.
events.quote: her subsequent warning to Kaito to leave the village

relations.note: She refused to help him and warned him away.
The nezumi fear retaliation from Tezzeret.
relations.quote: the potential threat of retaliation from powerful adversaries like Tezzeret
